question: Where is fast food restaurant found within 140 kilometers while moving toward Neil Carey Arena, IL from Hickory Grove Riverfront, Cary, IL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.207814 42.234515)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.082005 41.605308)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.207814 42.234515)',4326)::geography, 140000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.207814 42.234515)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
